title: IRS VITA/TCE Volunteer Certification
releaseBlockers: IRS VITA publications contain copyrighted TaxSlayer screenshots: never crop them
description: VITA: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
notice: the Elderly (TCE) and the VITA/TCE volunteer certification tests are programmes of the Internal Revenue Service. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by the Internal Revenue Service or the U.S. Department of the Treasury. Studying it does not certify anyone as a VITA/TCE volunteer: only the IRS certification tests on Link & Learn Taxes do. It uses IRS publications, which are works of the U.S. Government, and reproduces no TaxSlayer® screens (TaxSlayer is a product of Rhodes Computer Services). Tax amounts are for tax year 2025.

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 662 cards against IRS Publications 4491, 4491-X, 4012, 4961, 5838 and Form 13614-C, which they quote word for word as found by the card checker, and checked every amount against the Pub 4491-X corrections
checks.result: 1 wrong card (railroad retirement benefits are Advanced under the Pub 4012 scope chart, not Basic) was fixed and rechecked; 6 unsupported claims, 5 ambiguous cards, 1 unclear one and 8 minor issues were also fixed, and three scenarios too close to Pub 4961's own examples were rewritten.
